criteria.keep: Reusable domain model, distinct behavior/state/event, or recognizable independently configurable page/block pattern
criteria.remove: Only a static Card/Stack/Alert wrapper around already available primitives, with no distinct domain model or behavior

retainedRationale.site: Retain search/command interactions, color palette actions, user menus, theme customization and reusable domain cards.
retainedRationale.blocks: Retain official page-level Dashboard/Login/Signup/Sidebar patterns: they constitute individually selectable layout products.
retainedRationale.gallery: Retain domain cards (shipping, invoice, notification settings, finance, forms) as approved reusable patterns.
